verdict.rationale: Base44 provides a built-in managed database (Data page with tables/entities, CRUD via SDK) that is automatically provisioned with every app and wired in without needing external setup, as confirmed by both docs and an insider account describing the intentional choice to embed the DB in-platform. missing for 10: no independent hands-on verification of the provisioning UX itself, and no detail on schema/migration tooling within the builder.
